name: patch_rwxflip_ti_only
description: Direct patch of a TestTarget global bracketed by VirtualProtectEx (RW->RWX->restore). RQ3 evasion: only ETW-TI subscribed.

extra.notes: Writes 0F270000 (=9999 as little-endian int32) into TestTarget's `value` variable, with an RWX protection flip around the write. Expected fingerprint delta vs patch_direct: threatint_remote_protect_observed becomes True; threatint_cross_process_count increases by 2 (one PROTECTVM to RWX, one to restore). Attacker mask increases (RWX flip requires PROCESS_VM_OPERATION | PROCESS_VM_WRITE which we already have from --verify).
